raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Since 2026-01-17 reversals arrive as separate REVERSAL records and the original POSTED rows are never updated. The silver step keeps every POSTED row, so reversed originals are still counted, which inflates recent gold totals. Excluding POSTED originals that have a matching REVERSAL record (via orig_txn_id) restores the pre-change behaviour, where reversed originals were excluded.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.7, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(t.txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, t.customer_id, CAST(t.merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(t.amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(t.txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(t.txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions t WHERE t.status = 'POSTED' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM raw_transactions r WHERE r.status = 'REVERSAL' AND r.orig_txn_id = t.txn_id);"}}
